message: Astra: Stay with your array comparison. You displayed `[16.43, X, 37.24_]`, but assigned both X and 37.24_ to one position. That contradiction deserves attention before preserving your finding. Choose a simple way to separate the displayed entries and apply it now, in English; do not silently repair their characters. Then state what your inspection established, what remains uncertain, and the next action you choose—and perform it. Direct text inspection can establish placement, but without a measurement receipt it cannot establish a real measurement change.
